Fields.Name: AI Sound Volume Multiplier
Fields.Description: Normal when 1x. When set to 0, the radius of sound becomes 0 (SE and SFX are unrelated game-like parameters).

Fields.Name: On Hit [0] - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to a character for as long as it stands on this material (re-applied every update). Used in the first playthrough only: from NG+ on, the matching NG+ field below is used instead. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: On Hit [1] - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Second SpEffect applied while standing on this material, the same way as On Hit [0]. Used in the first playthrough only: from NG+ on, the matching NG+ field below is used instead. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Foot Effect Height Type
Fields.Description: Height of the foot effects (FootSfxParam) spawned on this material. 0: follows the foot. 1: locked to the water surface height. 2: locked at the height where the effect spawned.

Fields.Name: Foot Effect Direction Type
Fields.Description: Orientation of the foot effects spawned on this material. 0: follows the foot. 1: kept upright (aligned to world up).

Fields.Name: Floor Height Type
Fields.Description: 1: the floor is a water surface. The character's floor height becomes the water surface, which drives wading, splash placement and the other water-surface checks. 0: normal floor.

Fields.Name: Disable Fall Damage
Fields.Description: If set, characters take no fall damage when landing on this material.

Fields.Name: Hard Surface for Sound Reverb
Fields.Description: If set, this material counts as a hard surface in the sound reverb (echo) probing around the listener. 0: soft. 1: hard.

Fields.Name: Hardness Type
Fields.Description: The hardness of the material. Used for soft contact processing of rigid bodies.

Fields.Name: On Hit [0] - NG+1 - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Replaces On Hit [0] in NG+1 (second playthrough). -1 or 0: none.
